hypotheses.title: Batch 79: Tri-Candidate SUE Surprise Drift & Options Term Structure Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly elevates the highest-performing orthogonal signals discovered in Batch 78 while eliminating all unit warnings: (1) Unit-safe Standardized Unexpected Earnings (SUE) Surprise Drift with 5-Day Liquidity Timing in TOP1000 Industry Neutral (elevating Candidate 2 from Batch 78, which already scored Sharpe 1.26 and Sub-universe 1.54). (2) SUE Surprise Drift with Subindustry Neutralization in TOP2000 to maximize cross-sectional diversification. (3) Dimensionless Pure Options Contango Slope (1080d / 30d IV) with 30-Day VRP Fading in TOPSP500 Sector Neutral (eliminating all scalar additions and unit warnings).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if post-earnings announcement drift vanishes across subindustry neutralization.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(actual_eps_value_quarterly, 60) / close, 180), industry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(actual_eps_value_quarterly, 60) - ts_mean(ts_backfill(actual_eps_value_quarterly, 60), 252), 252), industry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Unit-Safe SUE Earnings Surprise Drift): Replaces the unit-mismatched addition with unit-safe time-series ranking of unexpected quarterly EPS surprise, coupled with 5-day liquidity entry in TOP1000 Industry Neutral.
